failures.question: 每个月的订单量，以及相比上个月的变化量是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)
  ORDER BY month
),
monthly_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    order_count,
    order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_prev_month
  FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
  month,
  order_count,
  COALESCE(change_from_prev_month, 0) AS change_from_prev_month
FROM monthly_changes
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 24;

failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
),
orders_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(o2018.month, o2017.month) AS month,
    COALESCE(o2018.order_count, 0) AS order_count_2018,
    COALESCE(o2017.order_count, 0) AS order_count_2017,
    COALESCE(o2018.order_count, 0) - COALESCE(o2017.order_count, 0) AS growth
FROM orders_2017 o2017
FULL OUTER JOIN orders_2018 o2018 ON o2017.month = o2018.month
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;
